newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico rates Bank of Ayudhya sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico rates Bank of Ayudhya sell.

text.p: Seamico Research said on Wednesday it rated Bank of Ayudhya a sell on its high exposure to the property sector and on expectations that it would have unimpressive growth this year.

Seamico said in a research report that Bank of Ayudhya had offered between 13 and 14 percent of its total loans to the property sector, compared with the banking industry average of nine to 10 percent. It said this added more risk to the bank's shares.

Seamico said Bank of Ayudhya turned in a net profit of 4.028 billion baht during the first nine months this year, up 13.8 percent year on year. It said the bank's performance was in line with its full-year net profit projection of 5.370 billion baht.
But it added the bank was expected to experience slower growth this year and in 1997 due to increasing stringent regulations imposed by the Bank of Thailand and Thailand's slowing economy.
Seamico said it maintained its sell recommendation on the shares and urged investors to switch to larger banks.
At 0807 GMT the bank's shares were trading at 82.50 baht, up two baht. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
